maintenance.title: We'll be right back
maintenance.description: Libriant is briefly down for maintenance so we can make things better for you. We expect to be back by {time}.
outage.title: Sorry — something's broken on our side
outage.description: Our team is already working on it. Please try again in a few minutes.
underConstruction.title: This part of Libriant is coming soon
underConstruction.description: We're still putting the finishing touches on this section. It should be ready very soon.
readOnly.title: Read-only mode.
readOnly.body: We're not accepting changes right now. You can still browse, but saves will fail until we're back.
crash.title: This page didn't load
crash.description: Something went wrong while we were putting this page together. Your library's records are safe. Try again — and if it keeps happening, send us the reference below.
notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.description: The address you followed doesn't lead anywhere in Libriant. It may have been removed, or the link may have a typo.
offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Libriant can't reach the network right now. Pages you've already opened may still be available — otherwise reconnect and try again.
